title: Ramona Optics, which makes microscopes that use AI to take and analyze large volumes of images of samples, raised a $25M Series A (Zachery Eanes/Axios)
summary: Zachery Eanes / Axios: Ramona Optics, which makes microscopes that use AI to take and analyze large volumes of images of samples, raised a $25M Series A — Ramona Optics, a Durham startup making advanced microscopes for universities and life sciences companies, has raised $25 million from investors in a Series A round.
